title: Marginal contribution and influence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in(0,1)$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the subsets of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Suppose $f$ is monotone under inclusion and takes only the values $0$ and $1$. For each coordinate $i$, its Bernoulli marginal contribution at parameter $p$ equals its Bernoulli subset influence divided by $p(1-p)$.
